digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md documentation and CI structural gates
propositions: AGENTS.md documents the 800-LOC module-size gate but does not mention the sibling C901 cyclomatic-complexity shrink-only ratchet that also blocks build

The C901 ratchet enforced by complexity-baseline.json (threshold 15) and scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py fails when functions gain new debt or exceed per-symbol ceilings, typically triggered by guard clauses or flag additions
Adding structural gates without surfacing them in implementer guidance causes unplanned behavior-preserving extraction refactors discovered late at pre-flight lint check
Documentation gap forces agents to discover complexity failures empirically rather than briefed on the constraint upfront alongside module-size policy
